answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**
单面板折线图，7 条分位数序列（Top 5% / Top 10% / Top 25% / Mean / Median / Bottom 25% / Bottom 5%），1997–2021 逐年约 25 个点，共约 175 个标记。无图例：序列名以内联文字写在各线右端点。线型区分序列——6 条虚线（Top 5% 为橙黄粗虚线，其余浅蓝细虚线），Mean 为深蓝实线。两条灰色竖向事件带覆盖全高，带内上方写 “Great Financial Crisis”“Covid-19 Pandemic”。y 轴标题 “Markup” 置于最高刻度 2.5 之上，刻度为 .5、1、1.5、2、2.5；x 轴标题 “Year” 在图下，刻度每 4 年一次（1997…2021）。图下还有三行小字注释，且注释中书名为斜体。标题块在图上方，分为粗体斜体的 “Figure 10: …” 与一段斜体说明。

**定位一个值难在哪**
以 0.58 为例：它只能是 Bottom 5% 早期某年。图上没有任何数字，y 轴刻度间距 0.5，5% 容差仅 ±0.029，约为刻度间距的 6%；而该线是浅蓝虚线，线宽本身就接近这一量级。年份也不是刻度年，须在 1997 与 2001 之间内插，行标签无法逐字取自页面。

**不确定的**
浅色水平网格线是否真实存在、各年精确取点、以及 1.50 与 1.52 分别属于哪条线哪一年，均为推测。

heading.title: Markups have risen more at the top of the distribution than elsewhere
heading.subtitle: Evolution of average markups in different quantiles of the markup distribution. Data from Annual Respondents Database X (ARDx) 1997-2020 and Annual Business Survey (ABS) 2021. GB only

worked_example.why_hard: pale blue dashed line, no printed values, ticks 0.5 apart, endpoint sits under label text

components.evidence: two grey full-height vertical bands over ~2006-2008 and ~2020-2021
"Great Financial\nCrisis" and "Covid-19\nPandemic" set over the plot area above each band
six dashed quantile lines against one solid dark-blue "Mean" line
"Mean" drawn thick solid dark blue while all other series are thin dashed
7 series over 1997-2021 gives roughly 175 plotted points
"Markup" printed above the top tick 2.5, left of the plot top
y ticks read .5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 bare; only "Markup" names the quantity
"Markups are calculated following our baseline approach... Data from the Annual Respondents Databes X"
faint horizontal rules at 1, 1.5, 2 across the panel; no vertical rules
note lines set italic for "Annual Respondents Databes X" and "Annual Business Survey" titles

new_components.name: event_band_with_inline_label
new_components.evidence: grey band spans plot height with its name "Covid-19 Pandemic" printed inside the band top

new_components.name: note_block_rendered_inside_figure_image
new_components.evidence: three lines of small print sit inside the chart graphic below the "Year" axis title

spot_checks.mark: the Top 5% dashed orange line at an early-2000s year (roughly 2003)
the Bottom 5% dashed line near the start of the series
the Top 10% dashed line at its pre-crisis level (~2007)
the Top 25% dashed line in the mid-2010s
the Bottom 25% dashed line in the early 2000s
the Top 5% line near its peak around 2015-2016
the Bottom 5% dashed line at the last year

answer.hardest_step_why: 无任何数字标注；y 刻度间距 0.5，0.58 的 5% 容差仅 ±0.029，七条虚线重叠，1.50 与 1.52 无法分辨。

examples.quote: seven dashed/solid lines between ticks .5 and 2.5, no number printed anywhere on the plot
examples.why: 逐点精度不可达：0.58 与 0.60 之差远小于虚线线宽，布尔式"可读"判定失效。

examples.quote: "Figure 10: Markups have risen more at the top..." then italic paragraph, then "Markup" above the 2.5 tick
examples.why: 编号、标题、斜体副标题与单位词分处三层，现有流水线只有单行标题。

examples.quote: 7 series plotted yearly from 1997 to 2021 in one panel, about 175 points
examples.why: 密度需作可控变量：七条同族分位线共面，超出当前标记数上限。

examples.quote: grey vertical band with "Great Financial Crisis" printed inside it, second band "Covid-19 Pandemic"
examples.why: 需新增事件带图层：带名既非序列也非刻度，却是定位与上下文的一部分。

examples.quote: no legend; "Top 5%", "Mean", "Bottom 5%" written at each line's right endpoint
examples.why: 序列命名位置需成为风格维度：端点内联标签替代图例，影响标签关联。
